# P0-P2 Phase F — Continual Harness refinement record

## Refinement cycle (amendment §16)

- **Trigger:** P0-P2 harness amendment (user-authoritative): adaptive fan-out replaces the hard
  2-worker ceiling; driver MAY execute trivial deterministic work; fresh-verifier role; sibling A2A;
  child recursion is daemon-blocked (RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1).
- **Classified pattern:** the global delegation policy (v3) still encoded the pre-amendment rules
  ("keep at most two children active at once" as a universal cap; no driver trivial-work allowance;
  no verifier role; no recursion note) — stale vs. the amendment and vs. measured campaign behavior.
- **Evidence:** amendment file §12/§31; live campaign practice on brain/p0-p2-production-core:
  adaptive fan-out width 2 used when justified; retained worker reused for 57.1% of task packets;
  fresh verifier caught a MEDIUM root-cause bug that 8 observations missed (C10 -> P0 PASS);
  RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1 proven by capability probe (Phase B).
- **Applied change:** `update_prompt_note(luna_delegation_orchestrator_policy, v3 -> v4)` —
  adaptive concurrency (default 1 active worker, hard ceiling 2 on this machine, config/env adjustable),
  driver trivial deterministic work allowed, fresh-verifier directive, sibling A2A allowance,
  recursion config-limit note. DeepSeek-v4-flash default and reuse-preference retained.
- **Rollback proof (simulated, local scope):** created local test entry `f_rollback_proof_test` v1 ->
  updated to v2 -> restored to original text (v3 entry version) -> verified content restored -> deleted.
  Rollback mechanics proven; the global base system prompt itself was NOT mutated (immutable).
- **Expected outcome:** future sessions orchestrate per the amendment without stale policy friction.
- **Observed outcome:** policy v4 active; subsequent orchestration continued without conflict.
- **Decision:** KEEP.
- **Refinement event id:** refine_0007 (global refinement history).

## Brain-vs-harness boundary verification (amendment §26)

- Project truth (architecture, decisions, implementation state) -> Second Brain canonical stores
  (memory/, decisions/, projects/ + derived SQLite/index) — e.g., the 5 seeded campaign memories
  and the writeback candidate mem-771d74aaa3fd.
- Operating lessons (how to delegate/orchestrate) -> Continual Harness (this policy v4, lean
  orchestration note, reuse preference) — no project facts placed in harness memory.
- The two loops were exercised separately and never merged into one bucket.

# P0-P2 Phase F — Continual Harness refinement record

## Refinement cycle (amendment §16)

- **Trigger:** P0-P2 harness amendment (user-authoritative): adaptive fan-out replaces the hard
  2-worker ceiling; driver MAY execute trivial deterministic work; fresh-verifier role; sibling A2A;
  child recursion is daemon-blocked (RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1).
- **Classified pattern:** the global delegation policy (v3) still encoded the pre-amendment rules
  ("keep at most two children active at once" as a universal cap; no driver trivial-work allowance;
  no verifier role; no recursion note) — stale vs. the amendment and vs. measured campaign behavior.
- **Evidence:** amendment file §12/§31; live campaign practice on brain/p0-p2-production-core:
  adaptive fan-out width 2 used when justified; retained worker reused for 57.1% of task packets;
  fresh verifier caught a MEDIUM root-cause bug that 8 observations missed (C10 -> P0 PASS);
  RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1 proven by capability probe (Phase B).
- **Applied change:** `update_prompt_note(luna_delegation_orchestrator_policy, v3 -> v4)` —
  adaptive concurrency (default 1 active worker, hard ceiling 2 on this machine, config/env adjustable),
  driver trivial deterministic work allowed, fresh-verifier directive, sibling A2A allowance,
  recursion config-limit note. DeepSeek-v4-flash default and reuse-preference retained.
- **Rollback proof (simulated, local scope):** created local test entry `f_rollback_proof_test` v1 ->
  updated to v2 -> restored to original text (v3 entry version) -> verified content restored -> deleted.
  Rollback mechanics proven; the global base system prompt itself was NOT mutated (immutable).
- **Expected outcome:** future sessions orchestrate per the amendment without stale policy friction.
- **Observed outcome:** policy v4 active; subsequent orchestration continued without conflict.
- **Decision:** KEEP.
- **Refinement event id:** refine_0007 (global refinement history).

## Brain-vs-harness boundary verification (amendment §26)

- Project truth (architecture, decisions, implementation state) -> Second Brain canonical stores
  (memory/, decisions/, projects/ + derived SQLite/index) — e.g., the 5 seeded campaign memories
  and the writeback candidate mem-771d74aaa3fd.
- Operating lessons (how to delegate/orchestrate) -> Continual Harness (this policy v4, lean
  orchestration note, reuse preference) — no project facts placed in harness memory.
- The two loops were exercised separately and never merged into one bucket.

# Driver Orchestration Contract (canonical, P0-P2 amendment Phase D)

Source: Driver-Orchestration campaign (2026-08-15/16), updated for the
Maximum Prime-Agent Harness Amendment (§12/§13/§22/§31). This is the
canonical orchestration contract for the **driver role** in the Prime
extension (`brainstem/prime-extension`). It is a runtime policy, **not** part
of the protected `constitution/` change-control surface.

Status labels: **IMPLEMENTED** = wired and proven; **ADVISORY** = guidance
only, no hard enforcement; **NOT CONFIGURED / UNVERIFIED**; **PLANNED**.

## 1. Role model

Four roles, resolved on `before_agent_start` (`src/driver-orchestrator.ts`
`resolveAgentRole`; precedence hard_orchestrator > driver > worker > normal;
lowercased substring match):

| Role | Default model substrings | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `hard_orchestrator` | `gpt-5.6-sol` | `ORCHESTRATOR_MODELS` (Sol guard, unchanged) |
| `driver` | `deepseek-v4-pro`, `gpt-5.6-luna` | `DRIVER_MODELS` |
| `worker` | `deepseek-v4-flash`, `qwen3.5` | `WORKER_MODELS` |
| `normal` | anything else | — |

## 2. Driver execution policy (amendment §31 override)

The original plan forbade the driver from executing routine work. Per the
amendment the driver **MAY execute trivial deterministic work** and **must
not personally execute substantial work** when delegation is advantageous:

- **MAY (Tier 0/1):** read kernel/context state already held; run one-line
  deterministic commands (status reads, single greps, `git status`) when
  doing so is cheaper than delegation.
- **MUST NOT (default):** bulk repo exploration, multi-file inspection,
  editing, patch application, test-suite execution, builds, DB queries,
  trial-and-error debugging, broad review. These are delegated.
- **Emergency escape:** documented, explicit, and logged (counts toward
  `emergency_execution_actions`); never silent.

## 3. Primitive-selection ladder (Tier 0 -> Tier 6)

Choose the lowest tier that reliably solves the step:

1. **Tier 0 — held kernel state** (variables, prior results in context).
2. **Tier 1 — deterministic shell/python/project command** (one-liner,
   no model reasoning needed).
3. **Tier 2 — existing Python-backed skill** (stable, tested, bounded).
4. **Tier 3 — retained worker** (idle/completed child with usable context;
   prefer reuse over respawn — no duplicate fresh child for the same task).

# P0-P2 Phase F — Continual Harness refinement record

## Refinement cycle (amendment §16)

- **Trigger:** P0-P2 harness amendment (user-authoritative): adaptive fan-out replaces the hard
  2-worker ceiling; driver MAY execute trivial deterministic work; fresh-verifier role; sibling A2A;
  child recursion is daemon-blocked (RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1).
- **Classified pattern:** the global delegation policy (v3) still encoded the pre-amendment rules
  ("keep at most two children active at once" as a universal cap; no driver trivial-work allowance;
  no verifier role; no recursion note) — stale vs. the amendment and vs. measured campaign behavior.
- **Evidence:** amendment file §12/§31; live campaign practice on brain/p0-p2-production-core:
  adaptive fan-out width 2 used when justified; retained worker reused for 57.1% of task packets;
  fresh verifier caught a MEDIUM root-cause bug that 8 observations missed (C10 -> P0 PASS);
  RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1 proven by capability probe (Phase B).
- **Applied change:** `update_prompt_note(luna_delegation_orchestrator_policy, v3 -> v4)` —
  adaptive concurrency (default 1 active worker, hard ceiling 2 on this machine, config/env adjustable),
  driver trivial deterministic work allowed, fresh-verifier directive, sibling A2A allowance,
  recursion config-limit note. DeepSeek-v4-flash default and reuse-preference retained.
- **Rollback proof (simulated, local scope):** created local test entry `f_rollback_proof_test` v1 ->
  updated to v2 -> restored to original text (v3 entry version) -> verified content restored -> deleted.
  Rollback mechanics proven; the global base system prompt itself was NOT mutated (immutable).
- **Expected outcome:** future sessions orchestrate per the amendment without stale policy friction.
- **Observed outcome:** policy v4 active; subsequent orchestration continued without conflict.
- **Decision:** KEEP.
- **Refinement event id:** refine_0007 (global refinement history).

## Brain-vs-harness boundary verification (amendment §26)

- Project truth (architecture, decisions, implementation state) -> Second Brain canonical stores
  (memory/, decisions/, projects/ + derived SQLite/index) — e.g., the 5 seeded campaign memories
  and the writeback candidate mem-771d74aaa3fd.
- Operating lessons (how to delegate/orchestrate) -> Continual Harness (this policy v4, lean
  orchestration note, reuse preference) — no project facts placed in harness memory.
- The two loops were exercised separately and never merged into one bucket.

# P1 Orchestration Gate Report (Amendment Phase D)

- **Date:** 2026-08-16 (session); P0 = PASS (report `p0-autoinject-gate.md`, commit 411abf8)
- **Scope:** amendment §12/§31 acceptance; original plan §7/§18-20 purity targets
- **Role:** WORKER (phase0a-audit2, reused for T-0A..T-PhaseD2) — report only; one sibling A2A exchange

## 1. Identity

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Branch / HEAD | `brain/p0-p2-production-core` @ `411abf8` |
| Prime | 0.7.2 (coding-agent 83a0f9f95) |
| Extension | C10 (commit b013650; deployed `~/.prime/agent/extensions/second-brain/` 10/10 hash; config-file mode branch live) |
| Config | `config/orchestration.toml` (f1a0c00): `[concurrency] default_active=1, hard_ceiling=2`, env `SECOND_BRAIN_CONCURRENCY_CEILING` |
| Brain | DB schema v8; pytest 703/2; vitest 245 |

## 2. P1 acceptance matrix (amendment §31)

| Requirement | Verdict | Evidence |

| Driver receives compact harness-native orchestration policy | PASS | `brainstem/policies/driver-orchestration.md` (f1a0c00, 108 lines) + Sol contract (index.ts) |

| Driver does not personally execute substantial work by default | PASS | campaign history: 16 delegated workstreams (T-0A, T-0B, T-0C1, T-0C2, T-PhaseA, T-PhaseC, T-PhaseC2..C10, T-PhaseD1, T-PhaseD2), all execution in worker session files (`~/.prime/agent/session-artifacts/01a007b1…/sub-*`) |
| Existing retained child preferred over needless respawn | PASS | `phase0a-audit2` reused for 16 tasks; no duplicate fresh child spawned for the same role (parent session `list_subagents` evidence: single phase0a-audit2 node) |

| Active steering live-proven | PASS | parent steers: T-0D1 continuation, C5→C10 steers, window-close steer (agentmsg records) |

| Fresh verifier path for consequential work | PASS | fresh verifier `verifier-autoinject` (idle subagent 6bc3f427d10b) found the C10 MEDIUM root cause → fix b013650 → P0 PASS (verifier-cycle telemetry, purity 1.0) |

# Driver Orchestration Contract (canonical, P0-P2 amendment Phase D)

Source: Driver-Orchestration campaign (2026-08-15/16), updated for the
Maximum Prime-Agent Harness Amendment (§12/§13/§22/§31). This is the
canonical orchestration contract for the **driver role** in the Prime
extension (`brainstem/prime-extension`). It is a runtime policy, **not** part
of the protected `constitution/` change-control surface.

Status labels: **IMPLEMENTED** = wired and proven; **ADVISORY** = guidance
only, no hard enforcement; **NOT CONFIGURED / UNVERIFIED**; **PLANNED**.

## 1. Role model

Four roles, resolved on `before_agent_start` (`src/driver-orchestrator.ts`
`resolveAgentRole`; precedence hard_orchestrator > driver > worker > normal;
lowercased substring match):

| Role | Default model substrings | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `hard_orchestrator` | `gpt-5.6-sol` | `ORCHESTRATOR_MODELS` (Sol guard, unchanged) |
| `driver` | `deepseek-v4-pro`, `gpt-5.6-luna` | `DRIVER_MODELS` |
| `worker` | `deepseek-v4-flash`, `qwen3.5` | `WORKER_MODELS` |
| `normal` | anything else | — |

## 2. Driver execution policy (amendment §31 override)

The original plan forbade the driver from executing routine work. Per the
amendment the driver **MAY execute trivial deterministic work** and **must
not personally execute substantial work** when delegation is advantageous:

- **MAY (Tier 0/1):** read kernel/context state already held; run one-line
  deterministic commands (status reads, single greps, `git status`) when
  doing so is cheaper than delegation.
- **MUST NOT (default):** bulk repo exploration, multi-file inspection,
  editing, patch application, test-suite execution, builds, DB queries,
  trial-and-error debugging, broad review. These are delegated.
- **Emergency escape:** documented, explicit, and logged (counts toward
  `emergency_execution_actions`); never silent.

## 3. Primitive-selection ladder (Tier 0 -> Tier 6)

Choose the lowest tier that reliably solves the step:

1. **Tier 0 — held kernel state** (variables, prior results in context).
2. **Tier 1 — deterministic shell/python/project command** (one-liner,
   no model reasoning needed).
3. **Tier 2 — existing Python-backed skill** (stable, tested, bounded).
4. **Tier 3 — retained worker** (idle/completed child with usable context;
   prefer reuse over respawn — no duplicate fresh child for the same task).
5. **Tier 4 — fresh worker** (new task, no suitable retained child).
6. **Tier 5 — adaptive fan-out** (independent workstreams; width from
   `config/orchestration.toml [concurrency]`: default 1, ceiling 2, env
   `SECOND_BRAIN_CONCURRENCY_CEILING`; no swarm without decomposition).
7. **Tier 6 — recursion** (root -> worker -> specialist; this machine caps
   child recursion at `RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1` — depth-2 delegation is
   **BLOCKED**; record as `recursion_depth` telemetry; simple work never
   recurses gratuitously).

## 4. Delegation purity (comparative, not vanity)

Original plan target: **>= 99% delegation purity** (plan §19/20).
Amendment §22: purity is measured and compared (baseline vs candidate), not
worshipped. Formula (implemented in `brainctl orchestration record`):

```text
delegation_purity = 1 - (driver_execution_attempts + emergency_execution_actions) / driver_actions_total
```

A single trivial deterministic action is not a purity failure; repeated
unnecessary driver execution is.

**Amendment §31 override (canonical policy `brainstem/policies/driver-orchestration.md` §2, commit f1a0c00; still only in git history — the M00 orchestration-removal mandate deleted it from this candidate):** driver **MAY** do Tier 0/1 only — use kernel state already held and run one-line deterministic commands (`git status`, a single grep, status reads) when that is cheaper than delegating; it **MUST NOT** personally do bulk repo exploration, multi-file inspection, editing/patch application, test-suite execution, builds, DB queries, trial-and-error debugging or broad review.

Boundary = *trivial deterministic* vs *substantial*: the only other driver execution is a documented, explicit, logged emergency escape (`emergency_execution_actions`), and purity is `1 − (driver_execution_attempts + emergency_execution_actions)/driver_actions_total` — one trivial action is not a violation, repeated unnecessary execution is; fan-out ceiling 2 (default 1), recursion depth 1 blocked.
